title: rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs: Off-by-one errors in test channel range assertions
description: Multiple tests use `< n_channels` instead of `<= n_channels` for upper bound checks. The channel formula `1 + (h % n)` produces values [1, n_channels], so channel == n_channels is valid. Lines 280, 281, 289, 290, 346, 375, 376, 393, 394 all have this error. These tests are flaky - they will fail when the hash happens to produce the maximum valid channel value.
